messages.content: How do I create a Python virtual environment?

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants to know how to create a Python virtual environment. This is a straightforward technical question that can be answered directly without tools.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Run `python -m venv <directory>` (e.g., `python -m venv .venv`). Activate it with `source .venv/bin/activate` on Linux/macOS or `.venv\Scripts\activate` on Windows. To deactivate, run `deactivate`.</content>
</action>
